premise: A misty morning: fog lies on the lagoon, the sun comes up and melts it away, and the whole valley wakes, stretches and says good morning — even to the sleepy old mountain far away, which goes on sleeping.
inspiration: The waking-world round of nursery rhyme ('Wake up, the sun is up'), ending on the one who stays asleep.
lesson: Every morning, the world comes back, one thing at a time.

en-US.title: Good Morning, Valley
en-US.text: {canvas:fog 0.8} {sfx:morning} [softly] Very early one morning, a soft white fog lay over the valley. It covered the lagoon. It hid the far red cliffs. {all:face sleeping} It even hid the sleepy old mountain. Everyone was still fast asleep. [whispers] Shhh. Then, little by little, {canvas:sunshine 0.6} the sun began to shine through. {all:glow 0.3 #FFE9A8} Warm… warmer… {canvas:fog stop} and the fog began to melt away. First came the giant lily pads, floating on the water. {all:pulse 0.3} Then the big flat rock, warm and red. Then the red cliffs, far, far away. {all:face normal} {all:wobble} [yawns] Everyone yawned a big morning yawn. {all:face happy} {all:hop} [happily] "Good morning, lagoon! Good morning, big flat rock! Good morning, red cliffs!" {all:sparkle} And last of all, far away, out came the sleepy old mountain. "Good morning, mountain!" everyone called. {all:face surprised} [softly] But the sleepy old mountain didn't answer. It just kept on sleeping, the way it always does. {all:face happy} {all:wobble} [giggles] And everyone giggled. {canvas:sunshine stop}

es-ES.title: Buenos días, valle
es-ES.text: {canvas:fog 0.8} {sfx:morning} [softly] Muy temprano, una mañana, una niebla blanca y suave cubría el valle. Tapaba la laguna. Escondía los riscos rojos del fondo. {all:face sleeping} Escondía hasta la vieja montaña dormida. Todos dormían todavía. [whispers] Chist. Y entonces, poquito a poco, {canvas:sunshine 0.6} el sol empezó a asomar. {all:glow 0.3 #FFE9A8} Calentito… más calentito… {canvas:fog stop} y la niebla se fue deshaciendo. Primero aparecieron los nenúfares gigantes, flotando en el agua. {all:pulse 0.3} Luego la gran roca plana, roja y tibia. Luego los riscos rojos, allá lejos. {all:face normal} {all:wobble} [yawns] Todos bostezaron un bostezo enorme de buenos días. {all:face happy} {all:hop} [happily] —¡Buenos días, laguna! ¡Buenos días, roca grande! ¡Buenos días, riscos! {all:sparkle} Y la última de todas, allá lejos, apareció la vieja montaña dormida. —¡Buenos días, montaña! —gritaron todos. {all:face surprised} [softly] Pero la vieja montaña no contestó. Siguió durmiendo, como siempre. {all:face happy} {all:wobble} [giggles] Y todos se rieron bajito. {canvas:sunshine stop}

morning.prompt: a calm, quiet misty morning by a still lake, soft water lapping, faint distant insects, realistic field recording
